messages.en:
{07 14 00}Thanks again for agreeing
to go bug-to-bug with me,
{04 1f 00}.
{07 00 00}Looks like nobody can beat
you! {01 00 00 05 00}You're, like, the
bugmeister of bugsburg!
{07 1a 00}I've got to hand it to
you, {04 1f 00}. You are
{04 03 00}'s champion!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Aitäh veel kord, et sa
nõustusid minuga putukates
võistlema, {04 1f 00}.
{07 00 00}Paistab, et keegi ei suuda
sind võita! {01 00 00 05 00}Sa oled nagu
putukalinna putukameister!
{07 1a 00}Ma pean sulle au andma,
{04 1f 00}. Sina oled
{04 03 00} meister!

messages.en:
{07 0f 00}I can't believe you beat me,
{04 1f 00}. I spent all
this time for nothing{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}
{07 00 00}Well, I guess I shouldn't
complain. I got to see a
bug master in action.
{07 14 00}I'm just glad I had the
chance to witness your
awesome bugging skills.
{07 1a 00}{0b 03 00}{04 03 00}'s lucky to have
someone with your talent
handy for bug emergencies!
messages.et:
{07 0f 00}Uskumatu, et sa võitsid,
{04 1f 00}. Ma kulutasin
kogu selle aja asjata{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}
{07 00 00}Noh, ma vist ei tohiks
nuriseda. Ma nägin putuka-
meistrit tegutsemas.
{07 14 00}Mul on hea meel, et sain
tunnistajaks su vapustavale
putukaoskusele.
{07 1a 00}{0b 03 00}{04 03 00} on õnnelik, et
sinusugune talent on
putukahädadeks olemas!
